generated_from: all supabase/migrations SQL text replayed in version order (grant/revoke/policy/raise lines); not from observed behavior. Phase 21 adds the portia_access_* functions and tables (migration 20261109000000_portia_access_foundation.sql).

outcomes.42501: permission denied (grant missing); message does not mention row-level security
outcomes.allow: call/operation succeeds (for a select: no error)
outcomes.rls-empty: no error and no rows affected/returned: the row is hidden by an RLS USING clause
outcomes.rls-deny: 42501 (or storage 403) whose message mentions row-level security: WITH CHECK rejected the row
outcomes.accepted:D-11: allowed at DB level on purpose; the section restriction lives in the API (accepted risk, not a denial)
outcomes.accepted:SEC-M1: allowed to anon on purpose (approve-state oracle; accepted risk, not a denial)
outcomes.P0001: function ran and raised the exception named in cell.message (the grant gate was passed)

accepted.reason: an editor with closed_tabs writes any portia_content section at DB level; the section restriction is enforced only by the API route
portia_editor_is_approved is executable by anon (needed before sign-up) and acts as an approve-state oracle

notes: 16-RESEARCH sketched outsider on reviewer RPCs as 42501; the SQL grants execute to authenticated, so an outsider reaches the gate and gets 'forbidden'. The matrix follows the SQL.
portia_promo_reset_device raises 'forbidden' for a reviewer without ownership (second raise), not 'owner-required'.

Storage insert-oversize/insert-bad-mime: bucket limits (baseline lines 1639 file_size_limit, 1640 allowed_mime_types) are enforced by the Storage API before the insert policy (line 1655), so anon and outsider get http-413/http-415 like editors; observed live in 16-12 (no object is written, plain insert stays rls-deny).

Phase 21 (21-04): portia_access_* probes never create rows: nicknames are '{prefix}-{role}' (the hyphen is invalid under ^[A-Za-z0-9_]{3,20}$, so submit answers invalid), uuids are the inert uuid, p_token_hash is '{token}', p_ip_bucket is a fixed 32-hex string, p_enabled is false (the default). Sources point at lines of supabase/migrations/20261109000000_portia_access_foundation.sql; moving those lines means regenerating the cells. portia_promo_register_attempt is unchanged until plan 21-05.
